success.description: You cast the spell, and add 2 recharge tokens to this card.

boon.description: Your allies may recover stress or fatigue or 1 wound.

sigmarsComet.description: Each ally within medium range may convert one critical wound with a number of boon dice no greater than the total generated on this check into a normal wound.

conservative.requirements: 8 power, must be outdoors or have a quantity of open water within close range. Effect: A warm, gentle rain begins to fall, infused with Ghyran, that restores health to your allies in the area. Each time you use this card, remove a recharge token from each of your allies within medium range who recover 1 normal wound.

reckless.requirements: 8 power, must be outdoors or have a quantity of open water within close range.
